site.texte: The application is temporarily unavailable during a maintenance operation. Your data is kept and access will be restored as soon as possible.

acces.refuse: The {{profil}} profile has no access to this screen. This right is set in “Access rights”.
acces.indisponible: This screen is not available on {{appareil}}. This setting is in “Access rights”, section “Access by device”.

intro.informe: This tenant has no e-mail: inform them by phone, by post or in person, then record the contact. A remark will be added to their record.
intro.relance: Remind the tenant by phone, by post or in person, then record the contact. A remark will be added to their record.

envoi.explication: An e-mail will be sent to each selected tenant. An “Information” remark with its content will be added to the tenant record.

avis.intro: Current tenants whose rent changes on a future date. Each send adds an “Information” remark to the tenant record, with the e-mail text. Tenants without e-mail are to be informed by phone, mail or verbally from the dashboard.

relances.intro: Unsettled rents to follow up. The message suits the case: full unpaid or partial payment. Each reminder adds an “Information” remark to the tenant record. For a reminder by phone, by post or verbally, use the row icon.

libre.intro: E-mail message sent to one tenant or to all current tenants. Each send adds an “Information” remark to the tenant record, with the e-mail text.

sansEmail.un: 1 tenant without e-mail will not receive the message.
sansEmail.n: {{n}} tenants without e-mail will not receive the message.

libre.erreurDestinataires: The tenant list could not be loaded.

APPLICATION.description: Messaging, display and security of the application.

expediteur.description: Identity used when sending e-mails to tenants.

organisation.description: Landlord details, available as variables in messages.

garages_loyers_locations.description: Formats and checks applied when entering garages and leases.

expediteur_nom.aide: Replaces the {expediteur} variable in messages and is shown as the sender name.

expediteur_email.aide: Address from which e-mails are sent to tenants.

reponse_email.aide: Optional. Receives tenants’ replies; otherwise the sending address.

cci_email.aide: Optional. Receives a copy of every e-mail sent.

org_adresse.aide: Optional. Included in the {coordonnees} variable in messages.

org_tel.aide: Optional. Included in the {coordonnees} variable in messages.

org_iban.aide: Optional. {iban} variable in messages, useful for payment reminders.

garage_prefixe.aide: Suggested when creating a garage (e.g. G05).

garage_chiffres.libelle: Number of digits in the garage number

location_duree_min.aide: In calendar months. Checked when entering the end date.

jour_limite.libelle: Payment deadline day in the month
jour_limite.aide: After this day, the current month’s instalment becomes “Late”. 31: late only the following month.

lignes_liste.aide: Garages, tenants, leases, payments and messages.

lignes_hist.aide: Histories, dashboard cards and tenant picker.

langue_defaut.aide: Used until the user chooses a language.

mdp_min.aide: In characters, when the password is changed.

maintenance_verif_sec.aide: In seconds, 5 to 300. Interval between two automatic checks on the “Site under maintenance” page.

modeles.intro: Subject and text of the e-mails sent from “Messages”.

signature.description: Added automatically at the bottom of every message sent. Do not repeat them in the templates.
